dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple closed-loop 'O' structures are visible along the dorsal midline. These features exhibit irregular, crenulated perimeters with a high-contrast gradient transition from dark charcoal exterior pixels to light-grey/beige interior pixels. A central cluster of three distinct rings shows particularly well-defined, high-intensity interior filling.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of small, solid, high-intensity light-grey blobs scattered across the lateral flanks. These clusters lack internal gradients or dark cores and are primarily concentrated in the inter-annular spaces of the mid-body region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent mid-dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary arrangement of four smaller annuli located on the posterior-lateral flank forms a rough trapezoidal polygon.
